verdict.rationale: Vercel's preview environments and isolated Sandbox execution (vercel-docs-1, vercel-docs-3, vercel-docs-12) let developers and agents test changes and run code without deploying to production, which aligns with the sandboxing story. However, there's no explicit evidence that preview environments guarantee isolation from production data (e.g., databases), and community notes (vercel-comm-11) suggest secure DB connectivity requires enterprise plans, leaving data isolation only partially addressed.
